component.name: DnfPilot
component.summary: Update Fedora with dnf and Flatpak, without Discover's offline update

description.p: A small window that runs dnf upgrade --refresh and flatpak update for you, with a progress bar, fold-out details and a restart button. One password prompt per update, no terminal.

The Repair menu covers the usual fixes when Discover's offline update keeps failing: cancel the scheduled offline update, reload package lists, resolve package conflicts and clear the PackageKit cache.
